visual_identity.core_identity: A flowing mass of ordinary rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide.
visual_identity.silhouette: A controlled directional stream of roughly 12–24 comparable small rat bodies with broad white gaps; no sea of repeated rats and no oversized leader.
visual_identity.head_features: Repeated simple rat heads with pointed snouts, rounded ears, whiskers, and visible incisors on a few foreground animals.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small four-legged rodent forms in varied running poses; no giant leader rat.
visual_identity.surface: Minimal fur lines and simple naked tails.
must_avoid: more than about two dozen visible rats
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one directional stream of roughly 12–24 comparable rats with broad white gaps between clusters; no oversized leader, no wallpaper fill, and no decorative frame around the art.

accuracy_checks: visible population is controlled rather than wallpaper-dense
rats stay comparable in scale with no giant focal animal

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A flowing mass of ordinary rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide. Small four-legged rodent forms in varied running poses; no giant leader rat. Minimal fur lines and simple naked tails.
